---
id: env.cover.relationship-with-public-liability-insurance
type: cover
heading: Relationship With Public Liability Insurance
since: 1.0.0
status: draft
---

Most public liability policies, including the Meridian Public and Products Liability wording, exclude pollution unless it is caused by a sudden, identifiable, unintended and unexpected event, and exclude clean-up of your own site and gradual pollution.

This policy is written to fill that gap. It applies as primary insurance for gradual pollution conditions, for clean-up costs and for natural resource damage. For personal injury and property damage caused by a sudden and accidental pollution condition that your public liability insurance also covers, this policy applies in excess of that insurance, as [[ref:env.pay.other-insurance]] sets out.
